PR (cited in the notes as #21065): feat: add a check for user defined role referential integrity [closed; labels ready-for-review]
Fixes #20825

- Adds a referential integrity check to user defined roles to ensure that at least 1 policy defines a permission for the role.
- Execute referential integrity check with `argocd admin settings rbac validate`
- Execute referential integrity check upon policy load. A warning is logged if a role is defined without any policy subject that references it.
- Fixed `cabin` -> `casbin` misspellings
